p: departed from Galilee: Passed over the water out of Galilee into the borders of Judea.
The Pharisees also came unto him: The band of marriage ought not to be broken, unless it is because of fornication.
put away his wife for every: To send her a bill of divorce; see Mt 1:19.
cleave to his wife: The Greek word conveys "to be glued unto", by which it signifies the union by marriage, which is between man and wife, as though they were glued together.
twain shall be one flesh: They who were two become one as it were: and this word "flesh" is figuratively taken for the whole man, or the body, after the manner of the Hebrews.
joined together: Has made them yokefellows, as the marriage itself is called a yoke, by a borrowed kind of speech.
They say unto him: Because political laws are adjusted to allow some things, it does not follow that God therefore approves of them.
because of the hardness of your: Being brought about because of the hardness of your hearts.
suffered you to put away your: By a political law, not by the moral law: for the moral law is a perpetual law of God's justice; the other bows and bends as the carpenter's bevel.
for fornication: Therefore in these days the laws that were made against adulterers were not regarded: for they would have no need of divorce, if the marriage had been severed by punishment of death.
case of the man be so: If the matter stands in this way between man and wife, or in marriage.
But he said unto them: The gift of celibacy is peculiar, and therefore no man can set a law to himself of perpetual celibacy.
receive this saying: Receive and admit, as by translation we say, that a straight and narrow place is not able to receive many things.
eunuchs: A man can become a eunuch in one of two ways: the first is by castration or emasculation, and the other by natural causes, such as a rupture.
made themselves eunuchs for the kingdom: Who abstain from marriage, and live as celibates through the gift of God.
Then were there brought unto him: The elect infants and little children are contained in the free covenant of God. (Ed.)
And: Those who seek to be saved by the law do not even know the law themselves.

thou wilt be perfect: The young man did not answer truly in saying that he had kept all the commandments: and therefore Christ sets forth an example of true charity before him, to show the disease that lay lurking in his mind.
Then said Jesus unto his disciples: Rich men have need of a singular gift of God to escape out of the snares of Satan.
easier for a: Literally, "it is of less labour".
camel to go through the eye: Theophylact notes, that by this word is meant a cable rope, but Caninius alleges out of the Talmuds that it is a proverb, and the word "Camel" signifies the beast itself.
And Jesus said unto them: It is not lost, that is neglected for God's sake.

regeneration when the Son of man: The regeneration is understood to mean that day when the elect will begin to live a new life, that is to say, when they will enjoy the heavenly inheritance, both in body and soul.
But many that are first shall: To have begun well, and not to continue unto the end, is not only unprofitable, but also hurts very much.
